comparison_baseline: Stage59AD pre-flat adapter s59ad_v64_gap14_t60_h4_entrytrans_sd5 with validation PF 1.02, validation cost-stressed expectancy below zero, OOS PF 1.22, and Stage59AF bracket-shape failure recorded.
decision_use: Route to Stage60 only if the full post-ATR/risk adapter evidence is strong; otherwise continue bounded repair, demote, or open another branch.
hypothesis: Bounded model-risk cap sensitivity from the Stage59AD pre-flat adapter may repair validation cost-stressed expectancy weakness if the weakness is risk-amplitude driven, while preserving OOS net, PF, ATR/bracket telemetry, and model-risk telemetry.
sample_scope: FPMarkets US100 M5 validation 2025-01-01 to 2025-09-30 and OOS 2025-10-01 to 2026-04-13.
stop_conditions: three bounded Stage59AG model-risk cap variants only
success_criteria: validation and OOS cost-stressed expectancy positive
ATR and model risk telemetry present
